Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: INTERACTIVE MODE (FM Pro): Run with no parameter. Saves XML to the temporary folder, POSTs to the companion (agentic-fm-app) /explode. Requires companion server running and $$AGENTIC.FM configured. SERVER MODE (OData via AGFMScriptBridge): Pass JSON parameter with keys: repo_path — absolute POSIX path to the agentic-fm project root on the companion server host export_path — absolute POSIX path where FMS will write the XML export (must be host-accessible) companion_url — base URL of the companion server (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8765) solution_name — (optional) override solution name; defaults to Get(FileName) NOTE: export_path must be a path FMS can write to AND the companion server host can read. On a Linux FMS container with a host-mounted Data dir, use that mount path. The FM path is constructed as "filelinux:" & export_path — adjust prefix for other OS. RETURNS (server mode): companion server response JSON { success, exit_code, stdout, stderr }
